title: Police Blotter: 11 booked in Webb County — end-of-day roundup
excerpt: Eleven people were booked into the Webb County Jail on November 10–11, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds — assault, theft, DWI and more. Every arrest is an allegation; each person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.
content:
Eleven people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Tuesday and Wednesday, November 10–11, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds, according to Webb County booking records. Each person is listed below with the charge shown in their booking record. An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction, and every person named here is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Kevin Eric Kirby

Kevin Eric Kirby was booked on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, on a parole violation hold with the Texas Department of Criminal Justice Parole Division. No bond amount was listed in the booking record. He was arrested by the Laredo Police Department.

Yazzmin Rihana Gonzalez

Yazzmin Rihana Gonzalez was booked on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, on an alleged charge of assault causing bodily injury to a family member, a Class A misdemeanor, stemming from an offense on Tuesday, November 10, 2026. Bond was set at $10,000. She was arrested by the Laredo Police Department.

Tiffanie Berrones

Tiffanie Berrones was booked on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, on an alleged charge of assault causing bodily injury to a family member, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond was set at $5,000. She was arrested by the Laredo Police Department.

Bernardo Napoleon Gonzalez-Mora

Bernardo Napoleon Gonzalez-Mora was booked on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, on an alleged charge of violation of a bond or protective order, a Class A misdemeanor, stemming from an offense on Wednesday, November 11, 2026. Bond was set at $50,000. He was arrested by the Laredo Police Department and was released on bail bond the same day.

Federico Serna

Federico Serna was booked on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, on alleged charges of assault causing bodily injury to a family member, two counts, and terroristic threat of a family or household member, three counts, all Class A misdemeanors, stemming from offenses on Wednesday, November 11, 2026. No bond amounts were listed in the booking record. He was arrested by the Laredo Police Department.

Ricardo Guevara

Ricardo Guevara was booked on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, on an alleged charge of driving while intoxicated, second offense, a Class A misdemeanor, stemming from an offense on Wednesday, November 11, 2026. Bond was set at $5,000. He was arrested by the Laredo Police Department and was released on bail bond the same day.

Eduardo Gonzalez Jr.

Eduardo Gonzalez Jr. was booked on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, on alleged charges of harassment, a Class B misdemeanor, and terroristic threat of a family or household member, a Class A misdemeanor, stemming from offenses on Sunday, October 25, 2026. Bond was set at $5,000 on the harassment charge and $10,000 on the terroristic threat charge. He was arrested by the Laredo Police Department.

Catherine Banda

Catherine Banda was booked on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, on alleged charges of theft of property valued at $100 to less than $750, a Class B misdemeanor, and failure to identify by giving false or fictitious information, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $4,000 on each charge. She was arrested by U.S. Customs and Border Protection.

Anthony Steven Lara

Anthony Steven Lara was booked on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, on an alleged charge of possession of marijuana under 2 ounces, a Class B misdemeanor, stemming from an offense on Wednesday, November 11, 2026. Bond was set at $500 on personal recognizance. He was arrested by the Texas Department of Public Safety.

Emily Nicole Alvarez

Emily Nicole Alvarez was booked on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, on an alleged charge of theft of property valued at $100 to less than $750, a Class B misdemeanor, stemming from an offense on Wednesday, November 11, 2026. No bond amount was listed in the booking record. She was arrested by the Laredo Police Department on a warrantless, on-view arrest.

Gerson Onuel Flores-Zepeda

Gerson Onuel Flores-Zepeda was booked on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, on alleged charges of accident involving damage to a vehicle of $200 or more, driving while intoxicated, and driving while license invalid with a previous conviction or suspension, all Class B misdemeanors, stemming from offenses on Friday, October 16, 2026. No bond had been set on any of the charges at the time of booking. He was arrested by U.S. Customs and Border Protection.
